To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
(i) a declarative language for data integration is feasible, and (ii) the integration of data in different formats can be specified using the same language as the specification of the data itself.

(a) correspondences between data in heterogeneous data sources can be computed in many cases using a declarative rule language, and (b) these correspondences can be turned into a translation rule set that maps data from one world representation to another.

(i) a declarative approach to data integration can be used for both correspondences and translations, (ii) the translation rules can be derived automatically from the correspondences, (iii) in the absence of order and duplicate information, the correspondence rules can often be computed in polynomial-time, and (iv) in the presence of order and duplicates, the rules may require exponential time to compute.
In summary, our research is concerned with
providing a declarative and efficient framework for data integration.
the development of an integrated data model, a language for specifying correspondences and translations, and a framework for data integration.
a declarative approach to integration, which is a key component of our overall approach to data management in a heterogeneous environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have shown the feasibility of a declarative approach to data integration.
we have a model and a language for data integration that is expressive enough to handle a variety of practical integration problems and efficient enough to handle them in a scalable way.
our model is a powerful tool to integrate data, and the language we propose is an expressive and efficient way to describe correspondences.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a declarative language for specifying the correspondances between data in heterogeneous worlds and for translating between these worlds can be used for solving the integration task in an efficient way, and that such a declarative language is useful for the integration task.
we have a complete declarative solution for the integration problem.

a declarative approach to integration can be made practical, and that it is a promising way to integrate data from the Web, where the data are often in heterogeneous formats and the data sources may change frequently.
The main takeaway from our work is that

data integration can be achieved in a unified declarative manner using a small set of rules, without requiring the user to specify the mapping between the worlds explicitly, and that the mapping can be derived from the integration rules.
data integration can be done using a declarative rules approach, which is a very powerful paradigm that can be used to integrate heterogeneous data sources in a very natural manner.
data integration can be specified in a declarative way and that the declarative rules can be automatically translated into executable ones.
